description: This file provides utility functions for converting Python objects to C++ numeric types, including packing and unpacking integers, floats, booleans, and complex numbers, specifically for use within the PyTorch framework. It also includes checks for object types and handles numpy compatibility.

methods.name: THPUtils_packDeviceIndex
methods.description: Converts a c10::DeviceIndex to a Python long object.

methods.name: THPUtils_packInt32
methods.description: Converts an int32_t to a Python long object.

methods.name: THPUtils_packInt64
methods.description: Converts an int64_t to a Python long object.

methods.name: THPUtils_packUInt32
methods.description: Converts a uint32_t to a Python long object.

methods.name: THPUtils_packUInt64
methods.description: Converts a uint64_t to a Python long object.

methods.name: THPUtils_packDoubleAsInt
methods.description: Converts a double to a Python long object.

methods.name: THPUtils_checkLongExact
methods.description: Checks if a Python object is exactly a long (not bool).

methods.name: THPUtils_checkLong
methods.description: Checks if a Python object can be interpreted as a long integer.

methods.name: THPUtils_unpackInt
methods.description: Unpacks a Python object to an int32_t, with overflow checks.

methods.name: THPUtils_unpackLong
methods.description: Unpacks a Python object to an int64_t, with overflow checks.

methods.name: THPUtils_unpackUInt32
methods.description: Unpacks a Python object to a uint32_t, with overflow checks.

methods.name: THPUtils_unpackUInt64
methods.description: Unpacks a Python object to a uint64_t.

methods.name: THPUtils_checkIndex
methods.description: Checks if a Python object can be interpreted as an index.

methods.name: THPUtils_unpackIndex
methods.description: Unpacks a Python object to an int64_t index.

methods.name: THPUtils_unpackBool
methods.description: Converts a Python object to a boolean.

methods.name: THPUtils_checkBool
methods.description: Checks if a Python object is a boolean or numpy bool.

methods.name: THPUtils_checkDouble
methods.description: Checks if a Python object is a float or numpy scalar.

methods.name: THPUtils_unpackDouble
methods.description: Unpacks a Python float object to a double.

methods.name: THPUtils_unpackComplexDouble
methods.description: Unpacks a Python complex object to c10::complex<double>.

methods.name: THPUtils_unpackNumberAsBool
methods.description: Converts a Python number or scalar to a boolean.

methods.name: THPUtils_unpackDeviceIndex
methods.description: Unpacks a Python object to c10::DeviceIndex with overflow checks.

methods.name: THPUtils_unpackInteger
methods.description: Unpacks a Python object to an integer type, handling overflow and unsigned conversion.
